description:
## Goal

New scenarios created from the template start with a working example tool and a pointer to the authoring skill, so agents copying the template see the pattern immediately.

## Expected Work

- Add `api/tools/example.go` (or equivalent) to the template that declares a trivial tool via the shared toolkit.
- Update the template README / scaffold docs to point at `tool-authoring` skill.
- Ensure `/api/v1/tools` works out of the box on a fresh scaffold.

## Acceptance

- A fresh scenario scaffolded from the template passes the scenario-auditor tool rule and exposes the example tool at runtime.
name: tool-authoring-template-scaffolding
title: Add tool scaffolding to the react-vite + go-api scenario template
